title: Top Small Phones for One-Hand Use (2026)
summary: The top small phones for one‑hand use in 2026 are the Apple iPhone 17, Google Pixel 10 Pro, Sony Xperia XZ1 Compact, and Google Pixel 9 Pro, each praised for their compact size, strong camera systems, and solid performance.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the provided sources (iPhone 17, Pixel 10 Pro, Xperia XZ1 Compact) and added the Pixel 9 Pro from a fourth source to reach five picks. Sources used: 0, 1, 2, 6.
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source explicitly states them; otherwise the price field is null.

products.name: Apple iPhone 17
why: The iPhone 17 is highlighted as the best iPhone for the money, with robust battery life, fast performance, pro‑level display, and capable cameras.
It offers a balanced feature set without a telephoto camera, making it a versatile choice for everyday use.
cons: Base model lacks some premium features
products.best_for: Users who want a premium iPhone experience in a compact form factor
products.skip_if: You need a telephoto lens or the absolute latest iPhone model

products.name: Google Pixel 10 Pro
why: The Pixel 10 Pro is praised for its top‑notch cameras and overall performance.
It balances camera quality with a compact design, making it a strong contender for photography enthusiasts.
products.best_for: Photography lovers who want a compact Android phone
products.skip_if: You require a telephoto lens or larger storage

why: ZDNet lists the Pixel 9 Pro as the best small Android phone, noting its great display and all‑day battery life.
It shares a camera setup with the Pixel 9 Pro XL, offering strong photography in a compact form.
specs: Same camera setup as the Pixel 9 Pro XL
